stem: Rina walked 7.5 km on Saturday and 2.36 km on Sunday. How far did she walk in all?
hints: When adding decimals, line up the decimal points, not the last digits.
Write 7.5 as 7.50 so both numbers have two digits after the point.
Stack 7.50 on top of 2.36 with the points lined up, then add each column from the right.

steps.why: A zero at the end of a decimal does not change its value. It gives both numbers the same number of digits after the point.

steps.action: Line up the points: 7.50 on top of 2.36.
Add each column from the right. Hundredths: 0 + 6 = 6. Tenths: 5 + 3 = 8. Ones: 7 + 2 = 9.

trapNotes.9.41 km: This adds 5 and 36 as if they were whole numbers. 0.5 is 50 hundredths, so 0.50 + 0.36 = 0.86.
trapNotes.3.11 km: This lines up the last digits, so 7.5 slides over and is read as 0.75. Line up the decimal points instead.
